grades.quote: Add AMCAS.B, AMCAS.H, AMCAS.W, AMCAS.D, AMCAS_DB.B, AMCAS_DB.H, AMCAS_DB.W,
grades.reason: Only lists new V1.1 atomic instructions, including _DB variants such as AMCAS_DB and AMSWAP_DB. It never says what the DB suffix changes about ordering, so it gives only limited context.
Describes the instruction-name prefixes and the .XX operand-type suffixes. It does not mention the _DB suffix or any ordering behavior of atomic instructions.
Encoding table for the base AM* atomics (AMADD.D, AMAND.W, and so on) without the DB suffix. It says nothing about what DB changes.

Encoding table showing the _DB atomic variants (AMAND_DB.D, AMOR_DB.W, and so on) as distinct instructions with their own opcodes. It does not explain the additional ordering behavior, so it is limited auxiliary information.
